item.title: Iran war shows norms of international conflicts have been overturned
item.summary: US threats against energy infrastructure, and Iran's retaliation on its Gulf neighbours, signal a clear change.

item.title: Russia launches 948 drones at Ukraine in largest attack over 24-hour period
item.summary: Cities across Ukraine were hit, with local officials reporting at least eight people killed and dozens injured.

item.title: Everyday life in Asia is being upended by Iran war fuel crisis
item.summary: Asia relies heavily on oil and gas from the Gulf, and shortages and higher prices are starting to bite.

item.title: Israel says it will take control of large buffer zone in southern Lebanon
item.summary: Thousands of displaced Lebanese residents will not be allowed to return home until northern Israel is safe, Israel's defence minister says.

item.title: Pilots killed in LaGuardia plane crash named
item.summary: Investigators released details from the final three minutes of cockpit and tower communications, which showed controllers cleared both the plane and a fire truck to cross the runway.

item.title: 'Like the plane got cut in half': LaGuardia crash that killed two pilots now under investigation
item.summary: Leo Medina, who was on another plane on the tarmac when the crash happened, told the BBC what he saw.

item.title: Journalists at Australia's national broadcaster begin 24-hour strike over pay
item.summary: Staff at the Australian Broadcasting Corporation are striking for the first time in 20 years.

item.title: Death toll from Colombian military plane crash rises to 69 as search ends
item.summary: The Hercules military transport plane crashed minutes after take-off near Colombia's southern border with Peru.

item.title: Oil at $150 will trigger global recession, says boss of financial giant BlackRock
item.summary: Larry Fink says if oil prices stay high for a sustained period it will have "profound implications" for the world economy.

item.title: Australia and EU agree sweeping trade deal in face of global uncertainty
item.summary: Australia and the EU sign sweeping trade and security deals after years of negotiations.
